title: Vote on releasing Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 RC1
summary: zhjwpku proposed release candidate RC1 of Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0, based on commit 9dbad3139df6fcdfc8d3f0bf6127dff9611ca9cd, with a vote open for at least 72 hours. Five non-binding +1 votes arrived within hours, some reporting verification of the signature and checksum, the CMake build, unit tests and the install step. manuzhang then reported that the generated `version.h` header is not installed, said he was unsure whether that blocks the release, and linked a fix. The release manager replied that the problem had not been found in previous releases, and that the vote would be aborted and an RC2 prepared.

positions.stance: The generated version.h header is not installed, which may be a release blocker; a fix is available.
The issue warrants aborting this vote and preparing RC2.

outcome.note: The release manager aborted the vote to prepare RC2 after the missing version.h install was reported. Five non-binding +1 votes had been cast.

why_it_matters: Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 RC1 was abandoned because the installed package lacked the generated version.h header.
